taskDescription: Arrange the Gram staining steps in the correct order from first to last.
paragraphs: Prepare a thin smear on a clean glass slide and heat-fix by passing through a Bunsen flame.
Flood the smear with crystal violet (primary stain) for 1 minute, then wash gently with water.
Apply Gram's iodine (mordant) for 1 minute to form the CV-I complex, then wash with water.
Decolourise with acetone-alcohol until purple colour no longer runs off, then wash immediately with water.
Counterstain with safranin for 30 seconds to stain decolourised cells pink, then wash and blot dry.
Examine under oil immersion (×100 objective) and report Gram reaction, morphology, and arrangement.
